QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] In My Day...
QuestInfo.0: What was someone like Parbell doing in a place veteran Explorers feared to venture? And what was he doing with a precious gem?
QuestInfo.2: What was someone like Parbell doing in a place veteran Explorers feared to venture? And what was he doing with a precious gem? \r\nHis answers shocked you. He said he was from  #e#bDawnveil#k#n, but you'd never heard of such a place. Was he from beyond the barrier? You wondered if he could help you.
